false_negative_recoveries.reason: VitaLLM changes the phase-aware accelerator plan through heterogeneous ternary/INT cores, KV-fetch prediction and dependency-aware scheduling; it is retained as bounded hardware/runtime evidence even though current Ch49 already owns the durable contract.

ScaleBox changes code-verification infrastructure and the evaluator/reward contract by jointly owning special-judge synthesis, distributed sandbox execution, test-case parallelism and reproducible suite configuration.

CuLifter changes the compiler/runtime evidence path by recovering typed register state, explicit control flow and multi-instruction semantics from SASS, with conflict detection as a fail-closed boundary.

The paper makes the end-to-end AI software supply chain a first-class system object across data, training, inference and substrate, but current Security/Production chapters already own versioning, provenance, observability and release gates.

TwinGate introduces stateful detection for decomposed malicious intent across individually benign requests; current Ch72 already owns cumulative intent state and preserves effect mediation as the authority boundary.
SimEval-IR changes the evaluation contract by separating behavioral realism from tester reliability and binding both to a canonical session schema, loss accounting and ranking-validity evidence.
